title: Puzzle callout banner
description: A pale violet rounded banner with a faint lavender hairline: an optional monospace eyebrow, a regular-weight headline and a paragraph (or small print) on the left, a dark button vertically centred on the right. On phones it stacks and the button goes full width. Used for a guarantee and for an audience-specific pitch.
notes: size 'lg' (36px headline) for a statement with small print, 'md' (28px) with an eyebrow
